outline: 透過簡短的寫作作業和課堂討論，本課程將幫助培養學生的英語寫作技巧和作文策略。 除了注意修改和提高清晰度的文體策略外，我們還將重點關注研究論文所需的準備和規劃——關注可能導致可行的高級寫作專案的問題和論點。Through short writing assignments and class discussion, this course will help develop students’ English writing skills and strategies for composition. In addition to noting stylistic strategies for revision and improved clarity, we will focus on the preparation and planning needed for a research paper – on the kinds of questions and arguments which could potentially lead to a viable Senior Writing Project.
schedule:
Week 1: Introduction

2-5: Arguments and Questions

6-8: Problems: Conceptual vs Pragmatic

9: Midterm week

10-13: Asking questions: senior project proposals

14-17: Lessons in Clarity

18: Finals week
